chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Shuʿayb, from Abū al-Ṣabbāḥ, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said to me: “We are a people whose obedience Allah has made obligatory. The anfal belong to us, and the choicest part of wealth belongs to us.”

key_terms.الْأَنْفَالُ: anfāl; properties and gains assigned by divine law beyond ordinary private ownership categories
key_terms.صَفْوُ الْمَالِ: the choicest part of wealth; the selected and pure portion of property
key_terms.طَاعَتَنَا: obedience to us; compliance with the authority of the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام
key_terms.فَرَضَ: made obligatory; established as a divine duty
key_terms.قَوْمٌ: a people; a designated community or household with a special divine station

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the obligation of obeying the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام and their right to al-anfāl?
ai.summary: This hadith affirms the divinely mandated obedience to the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام and states their entitlement to al-anfāl and the select portion of wealth. It reflects both their religious authority and their specific financial rights within the sacred order of Islam.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Shuayb, from Abu Al Sabbah who said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘We<sup>asws</sup> are a people, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has Necessitated obedience to us<sup>asws</sup>. For us<sup>asws</sup> is the Anfal and for us<sup>asws</sup> is the clean wealth’.
en.sarwar: 17. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayar from Shu‘ayb from abu al-Sabbah who has said the following.

“Abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) said to me, “We are the people obedience to whom is obligatory by the commands of Allah. Al-Anfal (properties acquired without the use of armed forces) and the best of the properties of the gains from war belong to us.”
